description: A shell script that tests 'git apply --3way' functionality including various scenarios such as conflicts, binary patches, and merge-style application.

methods.name: print_sanitized_conflicted_diff
methods.description: Function that outputs a sanitized diff of the current HEAD, removing index lines and decorative characters.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way
methods.description: Function that tests applying a diff with the --3way option, checking that it resembles a conflicted merge.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way_favoritism
methods.description: Function to test --3way application with different conflict resolution strategies (--ours, --theirs, --union).
